modules.title: WXML 怎样与其他文件配合

items.title: 数据变，显示跟着变
items.text: {{title}} 会显示页面数据中的 title。列表和条件写法还能根据数据决定显示哪些对象，不必为每个结果复制一页。

items.title: 使用小程序自己的组件
items.text: 微信小程序常用 view、text、button 等标签。它看起来像 HTML，但不是浏览器里的 HTML 文档。

modules.title: 写出按钮，就能完成预约吗
modules.text: 声明按钮不等于实现预约。还需要把按钮事件连到页面逻辑，再检查预约记录；浏览器的标签和接口不能直接照搬。

lessonPractice.title: 预约页需要新增活动标题，并在下面放一个按钮。哪个改动负责增加这两个对象？

options.label: 在 WXML 中增加文字和按钮标签
options.feedback: 模板负责声明页面上有哪些对象及其结构。

options.label: 在 WXSS 中调整按钮颜色和间距
options.feedback: 样式改变已有对象的外观，不负责增加这两个对象。

options.label: 在 JavaScript 中修改预约保存函数
options.feedback: 保存函数处理业务行为，不负责声明标题和按钮。

en.title: A booking screen needs an activity title and a button beneath it. Which change adds those objects?

options.label: Add the text and button tags in WXML
options.feedback: The template declares which objects are on the page.

options.label: Change the button color and spacing in WXSS
options.feedback: Styles change existing objects; they do not add this title and button.

options.label: Change the booking save handler in JavaScript
options.feedback: A save handler supplies behavior; it does not declare these visible objects.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 可以这样发给项目里的 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请在这个微信小程序预约页的 WXML 中增加活动标题和预约按钮，标题绑定页面数据，不要写死。按钮接到现有预约逻辑。完成后换一个活动名，确认标题更新、按钮还能完成原来的预约。

en.title: Send this to the AI Agent in your project
en.text: Add an activity title and booking button to this WeChat page’s WXML. Bind the title to page data and connect the button to existing booking logic. Change the activity name afterward and verify the title updates while booking still works.

steps.caption: The title data changes and the visible text updates. The text and button structure stays the same.

items.title: Bind data, rather than duplicate the page
items.text: {{title}} displays a field from page data. List and condition directives control which objects appear as data changes.

items.title: Use the platform’s components
items.text: WeChat uses tags such as view, text, and button. WXML resembles HTML but is not a browser document.

modules.title: Does declaring a button complete a booking?
modules.text: Declaring a button does not implement its action. Connect its event to page logic and verify the resulting record; unsupported browser tags and APIs cannot simply be copied.

distinctions.label: WXSS
distinctions.text: Controls the appearance and layout of the objects declared in WXML.

distinctions.label: JavaScript
distinctions.text: Provides the data and handles actions. A button tag alone does not save a booking.
